gloss: vertically long; tall and narrow; portrait-oriented

definitions.gloss: vertically long; tall and narrow; portrait-oriented
definitions.explanation: Describes an object or shape that is longer in the vertical direction than the horizontal. Used for physical objects, windows, screens, images, and document layouts. The opposite of 横長 (landscape-oriented).

examples.japanese: {縦長|たてなが}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{差|さ}し{込|こ}んだ→差し込む：04235_sashikomu⟧。
examples.english: Light streamed in through the tall, narrow window.

examples.japanese: ⟦スマートフォン→スマートフォン：04434_sumaatofon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{縦長|たてなが}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{設計|せっけい}→設計：03300_sekkei⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Smartphone screens are designed in a portrait orientation.

examples.japanese: {縦長|たてなが}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{家具|かぐ}→家具：12314_kagu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{配置|はいち}→配置：14409_haichi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: Because the room is long and narrow, it's difficult to arrange the furniture.

notes:
USAGE:
A な-adjective and ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧-adjective. A compound of ⟦{縦|たて}→縦：17236_tate⟧ (vertical) and ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧ (long). Very common in descriptions of room layouts, screen dimensions, product shapes, and image orientations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {縦長|たてなが}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧ (portrait-oriented screen)
- {縦長|たてなが}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧ (a long, narrow room)
- {縦長|たてなが}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧ (a tall, narrow building)
- {縦長|たてなが}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{表示|ひょうじ}する→表示する：26973_hyoujisuru⟧ (to display in portrait mode)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{横長|よこなが}→横長：20511_yokonaga⟧: horizontally long — the opposite; landscape-oriented or wider than it is tall
- ⟦{細長|ほそなが}い→細長い：06670_hosonagai⟧: long and thin — emphasizes thinness rather than vertical orientation
